notes: Version 2.46 records the I-4 correction in Q6a 2.6 and its consumers GS-Note 2.3, Q12 1.8 and GGS-Note 2.3. A gauge charge in Q6a, a function constant on the projection fibres, factors through the projection and is therefore a function of the observable state; its identification with a conserved physical charge is open. Q6a's two continuum hypotheses, a smooth effective fibre bundle and a differentiable spatial continuum, do not determine a connection: the structure group, its representation and the connection are supplied. On these data curvature measures the path dependence of transport, flatness gives a path-independent identification of fibres only locally, and the uniqueness of the Yang–Mills action is the standard result under an explicit truncation. Q12 no longer describes the connection of the admissible principal bundle as the unique one compatible with the Foundation constraints; it is supplied. GS-Note and GGS-Note no longer state that the continuum hypotheses suffice to obtain or construct the connection. The entries, table rows, graph nodes and the Q6a bibliography note are aligned. Inherited mentions of the two hypotheses in Q14, FM-Note, Q6b and the registry remain true as conditions and are unchanged.
